FROM SETUP TO AUTOMATION

Go live with PromoAutomation in 3–4 weeks.

We configure PromoAutomation around your existing data, brand and catalog workflow. From the first analysis to team training, we handle the implementation with you.

  • Workflow analysis
  • Branded templates
  • Team onboarding

Bring an existing catalog. We'll show you how it can be automated.

Week 1→Week 2–3→Week 3–4→LIVE

  1. We review your product data, images, pricing structure and current catalog production process.

    Questions

    • Where does your product data live?
    • Where are product images stored?
    • How are prices and promotions managed?
    • How is your catalog produced today?

  2. We recreate your brand rules and catalog layouts as automated templates, then connect them to your product data.

    Deliverables

    • Data mapping
    • Branded templates
    • Catalog rules
    • Test catalog

  3. We test a real campaign with your team, make final adjustments and train your users.

    Deliverables

    • Test campaign
    • Final QA
    • User training
    • Go live

Your product data (the Excel you use today is a good start), access to your product images, and an example of a catalog you like. We go through the rest together.

Not for everyday catalogs. Your template is designed once during implementation. After that, your team works with product data and the layout follows your rules.

An Excel spreadsheet, an API, or a product feed from your ERP or PIM. Most teams start with the Excel they already use.

From your data. Enter the regular and the promotional price, and the discount badge is calculated for you. Nobody retypes prices on the page.

Yes. Catalogs are ready for print and digital. Print settings are set up with your team during implementation.

Yes. Your team reviews every page before approving. If a price changes, update the data and generate the catalog again.

Yes. Every catalog follows your approved template, so colors, fonts and price styles stay the same while the products change.

Yes. In a demo we show PromoAutomation with your own data and a catalog you already make.

For repeat catalogs, often yes. For new campaign concepts or brand work, an agency still helps. We explain the difference on a separate page.

When an agency still makes sense

For new campaign ideas, a brand refresh or one-off creative work, an agency brings real value. PromoAutomation takes over the repeat work, the weekly and monthly catalogs, so that budget goes where creativity matters.

Home/Catalog Timeline

From kickoff to your first catalog in 1 to 2 weeks.

Here is what happens in each phase, what we need from you, and how every catalog works after that.

1Analysis

What happens

We look at how your catalogs are made today, your Excel and your image database.

What we need from you

Your current Excel, access to your product images and one catalog you made before.

What you get

A clear plan for how your data becomes catalog pages.

2Branded template

What happens

We design your template: products per page, how prices and discounts look, your colors and fonts.

What we need from you

Your brand guidelines and feedback on the first layouts.

What you get

Your approved template.

3Test catalog

What happens

We generate a real catalog from your products and check it together.

What we need from you

Product data for one real promotion.

What you get

A finished test catalog to compare with your current one.

4Onboarding

What happens

We create your PromoAutomation account, you choose your pricing package, and we train your users.

What we need from you

The names of the people who will make catalogs.

What you get

A team that makes catalogs on its own.
